title: Complex Hessian equations
summary: Spectral functions over RCLike 𝕜 (Lewis derivative, Spruck concavity), Gårding cones and admissible pairs with the structural condition, the equation f(λ[χ + i∂∂̄φ]) = c e^F on compact Hermitian manifolds with uniqueness by the comparison principle, Yau's theorem on compact Kähler manifolds (continuity method with Calabi's third-order estimate), the uniform exponential integrability of quasi-plurisubharmonic functions, and the Guo–Phong–Tong L^∞ estimates on fixed and degenerating Kähler backgrounds.

targets.name: relEigenvalues
targets.statement: For a Hermitian form a on a finite-dimensional inner product space E over RCLike 𝕜 of dimension n, the representing self-adjoint operator A_a with a(u,v) = ⟪u, A_a v⟫ and the decreasingly sorted eigenvalue vector λ[a] = λ(A_a) ∈ ℝⁿ; a ≤ b means A_a ≤ A_b in the Loewner order. Monotonicity and Lipschitz continuity of λ are the pinned Tau Ceti LinearMap.IsSymmetric.eigenvalue_mono and LinearMap.IsSymmetric.abs_eigenvalue_sub_eigenvalue_le.
hypotheses: E finite-dimensional inner product space over RCLike 𝕜

The two-sided trace inequality Σ γ_i μ_i ≤ Re tr(FB) ≤ Σ γ_i μ_{n+1−i} (γ decreasing eigenvalues of F, μ increasing eigenvalues of B) is recorded as von Neumann's inequality LinearMap.IsSymmetric.re_trace_comp_le_sum_eigenvalues_mul_eigenvalues applied to (F,B) and (F,−B).

Newton S_{k−1}S_{k+1} ≤ S_k² on ℝⁿ for 1 ≤ k ≤ n−1, with equality on Γ_n only for equal entries; Maclaurin S_k^{1/k} ≥ S_l^{1/l} on Γ_l for 1 ≤ k ≤ l ≤ n, and by continuity on the closure Γ̄_l, where S_1, …, S_l ≥ 0, in particular for every λ with all λ_i ≥ 0; generalized Newton–Maclaurin (S_r/S_s)^{1/(r−s)} ≤ (S_k/S_l)^{1/(k−l)} on Γ_r for integers 0 ≤ s < r ≤ n, 0 ≤ l < k ≤ r and l ≤ s, with S_0 = 1 (concavity of j ↦ log S_j on {0, …, r} by Newton, and monotonicity of chord slopes; Maclaurin is s = l = 0).

0 ≤ k ≤ n for the sum and shift identities

targets.name: garding
targets.statement: For p hyperbolic in a of degree m ≥ 1: Γ(p,a) is an open convex cone on which p > 0, p is hyperbolic in every b ∈ Γ(p,a) with the same cone, p^{1/m} is concave on Γ(p,a), and D_b p > 0 on Γ(p,a) for b ∈ Γ(p,a). For symmetric p of degree m ≥ 1 hyperbolic in e the cone is permutation-invariant and lies in Γ_1 (the permutation average of a point x of the cone is (σ_1(x)/n)e, and no −se with s ≥ 0 lies in the cone); it contains Γ_n if and only if every coordinate vector e_i lies in its closure, which symmetry does not force, and under this condition ∂_i p > 0 on Γ(p,e) (h(t) = p(x + te_i)^{1/m} is concave for t ≥ 0, and h'(0) ≤ 0 would make p(x + te_i) bounded on a half-line, hence constant, putting the line x + ℝe_i, on which σ_1 is unbounded below, in the cone; spruck2005 Corollary 2.4 omits the condition). For 1 ≤ k ≤ n, Γ(σ_k, e) = Γ_k (the inclusion ⊆ by induction on k, with base σ_1(λ + te) = σ_1(λ) + nt), so Γ_k is convex with Γ_n ⊆ Γ_k ⊆ Γ_1, Γ_k ⊆ Γ_{k−1} for 2 ≤ k ≤ n, and σ_k^{1/k} is concave on Γ_k with ∂_i σ_k > 0; on self-adjoint operators T ↦ σ_k(λ(T)) is hyperbolic in Id with cone Sym_{Γ_k}.

gaps.title: Weak Harnack inequality for nonnegative supersolutions
gaps.detail: For r > 0, B_ρ = B(x₀, ρ) ⊂ ℝ^m (m ≥ 1), a measurable on B_{4r} with λ|ξ|² ≤ a^{ij}ξ_iξ_j and |aξ| ≤ Λ|ξ|, f ∈ L^q(B_{4r}) with q finite, q ≥ 1 and q > m/2, and u ∈ H¹(B_{4r}) with u ≥ 0 a.e. and div(a∇u) ≤ f weakly (∫ a^{ij}∂_j u ∂_i v ≥ −∫ f v for all v ∈ H¹_0(B_{4r}), v ≥ 0): r^{−m}‖u‖_{L¹(B_{2r})} ≤ C(ess inf_{B_r} u + r^{2−m/q}‖f‖_{L^q(B_{4r})}) with C = C(m, q, λ, Λ) (gilbarg-trudinger2001 Theorem 8.18). The essential infimum is needed (u = 1 except u(0) = 0 on B_4 ⊂ ℝ²), and q ≥ 1 is needed for m = 1 (u_ε = (x²+ε²)^{1/2} − ε, f_ε = u_ε'' has ‖f_ε‖_{L^{3/4}} → 0 while ‖u_ε‖_{L¹(−2,2)} → 4). Used on coordinate balls for u = −φ with Δ_ω φ ≥ −A on Kähler manifolds (m = 2n, f bounded, u continuous); the homogeneous case f = 0 is pinned as TauCeti.PDE.exists_ae_setAverage_rpow_rpow_inv_le_mul_value, with an a.e. conclusion.
gaps.needs: the weak Harnack inequality r^{−m}‖u‖_{L¹(B_{2r})} ≤ C(m, q, λ, Λ)·(ess inf_{B_r} u + r^{2−m/q}‖f‖_{L^q(B_{4r})}) for every u ∈ H¹(B_{4r}) with u ≥ 0 a.e. and div(a∇u) ≤ f weakly on a ball B_{4r} ⊂ ℝ^m (m ≥ 1, r > 0), with a measurable and uniformly elliptic with constants λ, Λ, and f ∈ L^q for a finite q with q ≥ 1 and q > m/2
